name: City Lifeguard Jobs and Starguard Classes
org: City of Tucson Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: Pass a swim test, take the Starguard lifeguard class, then work as a city pool lifeguard.
who_can_apply: Must be 15 when you apply. Must pass the swim test. Must be free to work all of June and July.
duration: Starguard class days listed on the page, then June and July work
deadline_text: Swim tests Nov 1 and Nov 29, 2026, 11 a.m. to 1 p.m. Sign up for a swim test at the link. Starguard class days on the page (no years printed; the page footer reads 2026): Oct 4, 10, 11 (already passed as of 2026-10-13); Nov 14, 15, 21, 22; Dec 12, 13, 19, 20.
how_to_apply: Sign up for a swim test at tucsonparks.info/lifeguardfallswimtest. The page gives no other form. If you have questions, send an email to cotlifeguard@tucsonaz.gov or call 520-837-8119.
notes: The page shows 2026 in its footer, so the dates are likely fall 2026, but confirm. Swim test: 300 yard front crawl, 50 yard approach stroke with rescue tube, treading water, 50 yard side stroke with a dummy, 10 lb brick retrieval.
